Partners with finance on the annual budget and monthly variance across a £14m cost base; built the first operational reporting pack in SQL and Power BI.

Lead four operations managers and a scheduling team of eighteen through a weekly performance review against published measures; introduced a supplier scorecard for the eight largest contracts, reviewed quarterly against agreed service levels.
